highest_value_findings.finding: The historical FCWS lower bound on GT_n is carried by structural distinguishability of partial orders through minimal/tops/prune and novel branch points, culminating in at least 2^(n-2) nodes.
highest_value_findings.why_relevant: C023 robustness must track what the registered local Resolution pass does to this witness structure, not merely count resolvents.

highest_value_findings.finding: Graph/order tautology families that are hard for weaker caching/tree-like systems can have polynomial regular/linear/pool/clause-learning refutations.
highest_value_findings.why_relevant: A polynomial number of locally derived clauses cannot be assumed harmless; a strategically useful clause family may destroy the FC witness.

highest_value_findings.source: Samar, Vinyals, Ganesh, SAT 2026, DOI 10.4230/LIPIcs.SAT.2026.30, arXiv:2603.16156
highest_value_findings.finding: A fully deterministic CDCL configuration using a VSIDS-family branching rule solves Ordering Principle formulas in polynomial time, separating it exponentially from DPLL/tree-like Resolution on this family.
highest_value_findings.why_relevant: Provides a modern destruction atlas showing that learned-clause resource plus a concrete deterministic search policy can erase OP hardness.

highest_value_findings.finding: With clause learning and many restarts, a concrete solver behaves as width-k Resolution after O(n^(2k+2)) conflicts/restarts with high probability.
highest_value_findings.why_relevant: Separates the resource 'bounded-width learned clauses over repeated conflicts/restarts' from JANUS's one-layer local pass.

highest_value_findings.finding: DLL with unit-propagation clause learning is polynomially simulated by regular WRTI; broader DLL-Learn corresponds to regular WRTL. Variable extensions can raise strength further.
highest_value_findings.why_relevant: Gives a named proof-system map for returned learned clauses and prevents conflating this resource with Boolean residual caching.

highest_value_findings.source: Atserias and Muller, Automating Resolution is NP-Hard, arXiv:1904.02991 / JACM
highest_value_findings.finding: Finding a Resolution refutation polynomially close to shortest is NP-hard; short-proof existence does not supply cheap deterministic discovery.
highest_value_findings.why_relevant: Direct firewall against importing a short proof or powerful proof system as if JANUS could discover its proof cheaply.

highest_value_findings.source: de Colnet and Mengel, arXiv:2103.09609 / JAIR 2023
highest_value_findings.finding: For bounded-degree unsatisfiable Tseitin formulas, polynomial regular-Resolution length is characterized by underlying treewidth O(log |V|); lower bound is 2^Omega(tw(G))/|V| and is related to DNNF size.
highest_value_findings.why_relevant: Strong alternate structural lane if and only if an explicit simulation relation to JANUS-FC_local is later established.
